dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent O-shaped rings exhibit thin, high-intensity light perimeters with irregular, serrated geometries. These structures transition from a dark exterior background to a light perimeter, with internal centers primarily composed of dark pixels that occasionally show a subtle gradient toward a mid-grey interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of small, solid, high-intensity light pixel clusters is localized in the central lateral region, appearing as asymmetrical points that lack internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent dorsal-lateral annular structures form a complex geometric network consisting of a central irregular quadrilateral flanked by two scalene triangles.

other_distinctive_markers: A series of high-contrast, branching linear markings are present on the anterior neck and head region, distinct from the primary annular topology.
